title: Chora Church
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Chora Church/Kariye Mosque exterior:asymmetric mapped shell,east polygonal apses/buttress,four mapped windowed domes with shallow grey lead-like caps,curved chapel gables,selected arched glazing/blind fields,pale coursed masonry/brick bands and southwest cylindrical minaret/balcony/cone. Six existing shared graphs,eight merged material roles,four authored browser levels. Circular map roof boundaries are capped by domes rather than drawn as courtyards. Heights and unseen western/northern/roof fabric remain estimates;no copied mosaics or navigable interiors.
